title: Convert ProfileSession to @freezed instead of hand-written ==/hashCode
rule: naming/placement — domain/state models are @freezed, never hand-written ==/hashCode
why: ProfileSession is a domain/state model living under domain/models/ (the same directory as the correctly-@freezed ProfileModel), but hand-writes operator== and hashCode instead of using @freezed as the coding standard requires. Today's implementation looks correct, but hand-rolled equality is exactly the class of bug (forgotten field, inconsistent hashCode) the @freezed rule exists to prevent, and it's inconsistent with its own sibling file in the same directory.
recommendation: Convert ProfileSession to an abstract @freezed class with a private const constructor for the isActive getter, matching ProfileModel's pattern.
acceptance_criteria: ProfileSession is declared @freezed; dart run build_runner build generates profile_session.freezed.dart
Existing call sites (ProfileSession(profileId:), .none(), .isActive) keep compiling unchanged

corrections: First evidence line should read 23, not 22 — minor citation offset, doesn't affect substance.
